title: Over a Noetherian ring, a prime whose localization is associated to M_p is associated to M
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $M$ an $R$-module and $\mathfrak p\subset R$ a prime ideal. Let $R_{\mathfrak p}$ be the localization of $R$ at $\mathfrak p$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], with maximal ideal $\mathfrak pR_{\mathfrak p}$, and $M_{\mathfrak p}$ the localization of $M$ at $R\setminus\mathfrak p$ [def-weil-pbc-module-localization]. If there is $w\in M_{\mathfrak p}$ with $\operatorname{Ann}_{R_{\mathfrak p}}(w)=\{x\in R_{\mathfrak p}:xw=0\}=\mathfrak pR_{\mathfrak p}$, then there is $z\in M$ with $\operatorname{Ann}_R(z)=\{a\in R:az=0\}=\mathfrak p$.
